requirement.requirement_text: 业务用户提交一张商品图片，可以是移动端上传的图片文件，也可以是通过接口传入的远程图片地址。系统接收该图片后，先交由图片托管服务进行托管，并生成一个可供店铺使用的固定访问链接。随后由具备图像理解能力的语言模型识别图片中的商品，据此生成商品标题、HTML 格式的商品描述、SEO 标签以及建议的商品分类，同时生成五条要点式的产品卖点、最长 70 字符的 SEO 标题，以及基于建议商品名称生成的 URL 友好标识。系统还会对 SKU、价格与库存数据进行清洗与规整，形成可直接上架的条目。最后，系统按目标电商平台（Shopify 或 WooCommerce）对商品数据进行相应格式化，并在该平台上创建商品条目。若图片上传或电商平台接口调用失败，系统向调用方返回结构化错误信息。

source_spans.text: Turns a single product photo into a comprehensive, SEO-ready store listing:
📝 Captures Product Assets - Receives an image via mobile upload (binary) or a remote URL via Webhook.
☁️ Instant CDN Hosting - UploadToURL hosts the image and generates a permanent, high-speed link for your store.
👁️ Vision AI Analysis - GPT-4o Vision "looks" at the product to generate titles, HTML descriptions, SEO tags, and even suggested categories.
🚦 Smart Platform Routing - Automatically detects your target platform and formats the data for:
Shopify: Creates products via GraphQL-compatible REST with full SEO metafields.
WooCommerce: Creates listings via REST API with Yoast SEO support and marketing blurbs.
📊 Data Enrichment - Sanitizes SKUs, coerces pricing, and maps inventory data for a production-ready entry.
Zero-Copywriting Required**: AI generates 5-point bullet features, SEO titles (max 70 chars), and rich HTML descriptions.
Automated Slugs**: Generates URL-friendly "handles" based on AI-suggested product names.
Robust Error Handling**: Centralized logic to catch upload or API failures and return structured feedback.
